rulesEvaluated.description: Desktop renderer must never import from `electron`.
Desktop renderer must never import node:fs/node:child_process/node:https.
Desktop renderer must never import keytar.
Desktop renderer must never import a MariaDB driver or drizzle-orm.
Desktop renderer must never import ioredis or redis client.
Desktop renderer must never import from apps/server.
Desktop renderer must never import from apps/desktop/src/main or preload.
Champion scanner must not import Phase 2A-2F observer modules.
Observer modules must not import champion economic writers.
No file may dynamically import electron.
